entries.notes: Selected the ordinary first-order EFA/PCA solution for the Japanese TAS-20. Table 3 reports item-factor loadings only for the psychiatric outpatient sample; the paper states similar results for college students were found but not shown, so no college-student loading sample was extracted. Factor mapping follows printed columns: F1 = Difficulty Identifying Feelings, F2 = Difficulty Describing Feelings, F3 = Externally Oriented Thinking. Only one loading per item is printed in Table 3; nonprinted cross-loadings were coded null. Varimax is an orthogonal rotation, so off-diagonal factor correlations for the selected EFA solution were set to 0; Table 5 Pearson correlations among factor scores were not treated as latent factor correlations. Female percentage computed from 77 women out of 149.
